records.gloss: Of David. I will give you thanks with all my heart; before [the] gods I will sing praises to you.
pieces: Of David. With all my heart I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks; in the presence of the gods I will make music for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

L.1: Of David. I will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks with all my heart; before [the] gods I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

R.1: By David. I will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all my heart. I will sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in front of the gods.

decisions.choice: The title shares verse 1
decisions.reason: This psalm's title is short and the Hebrew counts it together with the first line as verse 1, so here the verse numbers are the same as in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the last psalms of David
decisions.reason: Psalms 138-145 are the last group of psalms in the book that carry David's name.

decisions.choice: before the gods: in the face of the gods the nations worship
alternatives: before the angels (the ancient Greek translation)
decisions.reason: The word ('elohim) can mean God, gods, or heavenly beings. Here it is plural: the singer praises the LORD openly, in defiance of the gods of the nations (verse 4 speaks of their kings). The ancient Greek translation reads "before the angels".

decisions.choice: I will give you thanks: no name in the Hebrew text
alternatives: I will give you thanks, LORD
decisions.reason: Some Hebrew manuscripts and the ancient Greek translation add "LORD" after the first verb. The text here does not have it; the LORD is named in verse 4.

decisions.choice: With all my heart first (B)
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the phrase first for emphasis; the meaning is the same.

records.heading: Thanks for an answered prayer

records.source: אֶשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֨ה אֶל־הֵיכַ֪ל קָדְשְׁךָ֡ וְא֘וֹדֶ֤ה אֶת־שְׁמֶ֗ךָ עַל־חַסְדְּךָ֥ וְעַל־אֲמִתֶּ֑ךָ כִּֽי־הִגְדַּ֥לְתָּ עַל־כָּל־שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ אִמְרָתֶֽךָ׃
records.gloss: I will bow down toward [the] temple of your holiness and give thanks to your name for your loyal love and for your faithfulness, for you have made great above all your name your word.
pieces: I will bow down facing {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple and praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness; for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise great, beyond all that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name had made known.

L.2: I will bow down toward {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple and give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love and for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word great above all {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.

R.2: I will bow down toward {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy temple. I will praise {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love and because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} always do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} say. What {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} promised and did is even greater than everything people knew about {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

decisions.choice: bow toward your holy temple: as in 5:8
decisions.reason: Psalm 5:8 has the same words. Worshipers bowed toward the temple, even from far away (1 Kings 8:29-30, 35).

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: faithfulness: being true and reliable
decisions.reason: The word ('emet) is firmness, truth, being reliable. With loyal love it describes God's character (Exodus 34:6).

decisions.choice: you have made your word great above all your name: the promise kept surpasses all that was known of God
alternatives: you have exalted your name and your word above all things
you have made your name and your word great above everything
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "you have made great, above all your name, your word". Taken as it stands, God's word (his promise, now kept) has gone beyond all that his name had stood for until then. Many read it, with a small change, as "you have exalted your name and your word above all things".

decisions.choice: your word: your promise
decisions.reason: The word ('imrah) is a saying or word, often a promise (119:38).

decisions.choice: because you always do what you say
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's faithfulness is (m3).

decisions.choice: promise
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "promise", what God's word is here (m5).

records.source: בְּי֣וֹם קָ֭רָֽאתִי וַֽתַּעֲנֵ֑נִי תַּרְהִבֵ֖נִי בְנַפְשִׁ֣י עֹֽז׃
records.gloss: On [the] day I called, and you answered me; you made me bold in my soul [with] strength.
pieces: The day I called, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered me; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} filled me with courage and strength within.

L.3: On the day I called, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered me; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made me bold [with] strength in my soul.

R.3: When I called out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} answered me. You made me brave and strong inside.

decisions.choice: made me bold: gave me courage
decisions.reason: The verb (rahav, causative) is rare. It seems to mean to make someone bold or confident, here with new strength.

decisions.choice: in my soul: within me
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) is the whole inner person: the strength is courage, not muscle.

decisions.choice: within (B); inside (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "within" or "inside" for nefesh here (m2).

records.source: יוֹד֣וּךָ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־מַלְכֵי־אָ֑רֶץ כִּ֥י שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ אִמְרֵי־פִֽיךָ׃
records.gloss: They will give you thanks, YHWH, all [the] kings of [the] earth, for they have heard [the] words of your mouth.
pieces: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, every king on earth will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, because they have heard the words {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} spoke.

L.4: All the kings of the earth will give {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} thanks, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for they have heard the words of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mouth.

R.4: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, every king in the world will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} after hearing the words {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken.

decisions.choice: they will give thanks: a confident hope
alternatives: may all the kings give you thanks
decisions.reason: The verb can be read as "they will" or as a wish, "may they". The kings hear of what God has said and done for the singer (verses 2-3), and turn to praise him (102:16; 72:11).

decisions.choice: the words of your mouth: what you have said
decisions.reason: The words God has spoken, his promise kept (verse 2).

records.source: וְ֭יָשִׁירוּ בְּדַרְכֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י גָ֝ד֗וֹל כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָֽה׃
records.gloss: And they will sing in [the] ways of YHWH, for great [is the] glory of YHWH.
pieces: They will sing of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s ways, because the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is so great.

L.5: And they will sing of the ways of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for great [is] the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

R.5: They will sing about the way {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} acts, because the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is so great.

decisions.choice: the ways of the LORD: how he acts
alternatives: they will sing as they walk in the ways of the LORD
decisions.reason: The "ways" of the LORD are what he does and how he deals with people (103:7). The Hebrew "sing in" may be "sing about" or "sing while walking in"; the first suits the kings who have heard his words.

decisions.choice: glory: the LORD's weight and splendor
decisions.reason: Glory (kavod) is the weight and splendor of the LORD as he shows himself (19:2; 24:7-10).

records.source: כִּי־רָ֣ם יְ֭הוָה וְשָׁפָ֣ל יִרְאֶ֑ה וְ֝גָבֹ֗הַּ מִמֶּרְחָ֥ק יְיֵדָֽע׃
records.gloss: For high [is] YHWH, and the lowly he sees, and the proud from afar he knows.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is high, yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} looks upon those who are low; the proud {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knows from a distance.

L.6: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] high, yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sees the lowly; and the proud {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} knows from afar.

R.6: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is high above everything, yet {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} cares for humble people. But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps proud people at a distance and knows all about them from far away.

decisions.choice: the high God sees the lowly
decisions.reason: The LORD is exalted above all, yet he pays attention to those who are humble and humbled (113:5-7; Isaiah 57:15).

decisions.choice: the proud he knows from afar: he sees them but keeps them far off
alternatives: even from far away he sees through the proud
decisions.reason: "From afar" may say that God keeps the proud at a distance, while he comes near the lowly, or that nothing about them escapes him even from far away. Both fit the contrast.

decisions.choice: cares for
decisions.reason: When God sees the lowly he notices and helps them (m1); Readable says so.

decisions.choice: keeps proud people at a distance
decisions.reason: Readable says both things the words of m2 imply.

records.source: אִם־אֵלֵ֤ךְ׀בְּקֶ֥רֶב צָרָ֗ה תְּחַ֫יֵּ֥נִי עַ֤ל אַ֣ף אֹ֭יְבַיתִּשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֑ךָ וְת֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי יְמִינֶֽךָ׃
records.gloss: If I walk in [the] midst of trouble, you preserve me alive; against [the] anger of my enemies you stretch out your hand, and your right hand saves me.
pieces: Even when I walk through the middle of trouble, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep me alive. You reach out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand against my enemies' fury, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand rescues me.

L.7: If I walk in the midst of trouble, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep me alive; against the anger of my enemies {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} stretch out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand, and {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} right hand saves me.

R.7: Even when trouble is all around me, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} keep me alive. You reach out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hand to stop my angry enemies. Your powerful right hand saves me.

decisions.choice: preserve me alive: keep me alive
decisions.reason: The verb (chayah, intensive) means to keep alive or to bring back to life; here, to keep the singer alive in danger.

decisions.choice: your right hand: your power
decisions.reason: The right hand, the stronger hand, is a picture of God's power to save (20:7; 118:15-16).

decisions.choice: powerful
decisions.reason: Readable says what the right hand stands for (m2).

records.source: יְהוָה֮ יִגְמֹ֪ר בַּ֫עֲדִ֥י יְ֭הוָה חַסְדְּךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם מַעֲשֵׂ֖י יָדֶ֣יךָ אַל־תֶּֽרֶף׃
records.gloss: YHWH will complete [it] for me; YHWH, your loyal love [is] forever; [the] works of your hands do not abandon.
pieces: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will carry out {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} plan for me. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love lasts forever; do not let go of what {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands have made.

L.8: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will complete [it] for me; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love [is] forever; do not let go of the works of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} hands.

R.8: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will do everything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has planned for me. {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love lasts forever. Do not walk away from what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made.

decisions.choice: will complete for me: will carry his purpose through
decisions.reason: As in 57:3, the verb (gamar) means to bring to an end or complete: God finishes what he has begun for his servant.

decisions.choice: loyal love: faithful, covenant love
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith within a bond, here the LORD's love for his people. Literal and Balanced say "loyal love", Readable "faithful love".

decisions.choice: the works of your hands: what God has made and begun
alternatives: the singer himself, made by God
decisions.reason: The singer may mean himself, as one God has made (139:13-16; Job 10:3, 8), or all that God has begun to do for him. Either way he asks God to finish it.

decisions.choice: his plan (B); everything he has planned (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable supply the object the verb implies, as in 57:3 (m1).

decisions.choice: do not let go of (L, B); do not walk away from (R)
decisions.reason: The verb (rafah, causative) is to let drop or let go, a picture of a hand releasing its hold.
